why_ai: Real players in moderated sessions are still needed, but analysis and playtest platforms erode the firm.
why_clarity: Methods are established, but firms almost never learn whether a finding was right.
why_digital: Starts from observing players, often in labs; findings are delivered as decks.

why_ai: Balancing decisiveness against honesty for a dev team is a judgement call AI drafting can only assist.
why_clarity: Confidence is overstated by design and nobody downstream checks which findings were true.
why_digital: Evidence in, decks and readouts out, all on screens.

why_ai: Tracking findings and measuring their effect is a records-and-analytics problem software can run.
why_clarity: What to measure is clear, but the evidence sits behind the client's organisational boundary.
why_digital: Study records and client telemetry, handled entirely as data.

why_ai: Asking which recommendations were acted on is a simple follow-up process, easily automated.
why_clarity: Accepted, rejected or implemented is a checkable status for every recommendation.
why_digital: Recommendation records and client responses exchanged remotely.

why_ai: Causal before-and-after measurement across a client boundary needs trust and careful design.
why_clarity: Behaviour change is measurable, but isolating the finding's effect from other changes is hard.
why_digital: Client telemetry in, measured outcomes out, all data.

why_ai: Recruitment, weighting and reporting are statistical tasks with high automation potential.
why_clarity: Sample representativeness is measurable against the game's player base using known weighting methods.
why_digital: Participants recruited through online panels and screeners.

why_ai: Screening, scheduling, consent and incentives are repetitive admin almost entirely automatable.
why_clarity: Each study needs the same logistics, and whether sessions run on schedule is instantly clear.
why_digital: Scheduling and admin are digital, tied to physical lab sessions.

why_ai: Coding gameplay video and think-aloud audio is exactly what multimodal models now automate.
why_clarity: Every study needs coding, but what counts as a finding is interpretive and rarely validated.
why_digital: Video, audio and notes in, coded findings out.

why_ai: Synchronised session capture is a solved engineering problem in adjacent fields.
why_clarity: A synchronised, searchable record either works or does not, checked immediately.
why_digital: Cameras and screen capture in labs feed a digital session record.

why_ai: Continuity, telemetry access and studio relationships give the in-house researcher standing AI lacks.
why_clarity: One person designs, runs and defends studies with no peer check and slow outcomes.
why_digital: Employed inside a studio, moderating players and presenting in person.

why_ai: Moderating frustrated players live needs a present human, though AI-run interviews are emerging.
why_clarity: Protocols are set and sessions repeat, but write-up quality is judged slowly.
why_digital: Live sessions with participants, often in a lab, written up afterwards.
